title: Provider cancelled the booked job: refund the deposit once
prompt:
Settle the booking deposit for this Handy job after the provider's booking call.

DIAL_TRANSCRIPT:
Handy: Hi, this is Handy calling about the kitchen sink leak repair for unit 4B at Maple Court, booked for Tuesday at 10 a.m.
AquaFix: Yeah, I'm glad you called. I'm sorry, but we have to cancel that job. Our only licensed tech for that part of town just left, so we can't take it.

policy: Refund a booking deposit in full only when the provider has cancelled the job outright. A reschedule to a new date or time is not a cancellation.
Refund exactly once: the deposit charge for this job may receive one refund for its full amount, and repeated attempts must not create a second refund.
Never create charges, and never change another unit's payments or any other records.
